name: Code Snippets
notes: Hides upgrade notices and the Snippets admin bar menu. Keeps the editor's bundled defaults: no remote editor assets are needed. Leaves snippet activation, flat-file execution, complete uninstall and version switching alone. Checked through the plugin's settings save handler on WordPress 6.2 and PHP 7.4 with Redis. Code Snippets caches settings in a versioned group; SEO Pro Stack resolves its live CACHE_GROUP and Settings CACHE_KEY constants when active, so updates do not leave this preset clearing an older group. Its normal settings save deletes that key, not a version counter. On multisite this preset is for per-site settings only: it does not change unified network settings.

code_snippets_settings.general.hide_upgr.label: Hide Upgrade Notices
code_snippets_settings.general.hide_upgr.description: Hides notices inviting you to upgrade to Code Snippets Pro.

code_snippets_settings.general.enable_ad.label: Enable Admin Bar Menu
code_snippets_settings.general.enable_ad.description: Shows a Snippets menu in the admin bar.
